Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: arcade fighting-game animation sprite sheet derived from the provided Yafa portrait (reference for identity and outfit). Yafa — Guardião da Apólice: the exact adult man from the reference portrait. Older middle-aged stocky heavyset man with bald crown and short grey hair at sides, round warm tan face, broad nose, dark thick eyebrows, brown eyes, clean-shaven face. White open-collar office shirt, sleeves rolled to forearms, tiny navy/gold YAFA badge, dark navy tailored trousers, black belt with gold buckle, polished black shoes, gold wristwatch. Navy insurance briefcase with gold clasps and a small shield emblem held CLOSE to his LEFT rear hip, firmly in his left hand; no detached briefcase or papers. Right forward hand is free for punches and blue/gold energy shield. Keep his stocky belly and modest office-clothing silhouette, not a lean bodybuilder. No new hair or beard, no gloves.
Style: same detailed hand-drawn 1990s arcade sprite shading as the reference, visible crisp pixel-like contours, original office-themed fighter. Facing RIGHT in EVERY frame in three-quarter side-view. Full body including both shoes and briefcase. One coherent character with identical face, head size, proportions and clothing in every frame.
Layout: exactly SIX evenly spaced columns and FOUR evenly spaced rows, 24 complete sprites on a landscape 1536x1024 canvas, 256x256 logical cells. Every complete silhouette entirely INSIDE its own cell, at least 20px transparent margins on all sides. No body parts or bags across cell boundaries. No background, floor, drop shadows, labels, gridlines, borders, detached pieces or extra people. TRUE transparent alpha background. Six distinct consecutive animation frames per row, left-to-right, maintain common foot/contact baseline and the same body scale. Game physics controls actual displacement, keep aerial characters centered in their own cells. Briefcase must remain attached to the hand/body, NO scattered papers.
ROW 1: Idle fighting guard: relaxed guard, subtle belly/shoulder breathing and weight shift, six distinct poses, last returns smoothly to first.
ROW 2: Forward WALK to RIGHT: contact, down, passing, up, opposite contact, passing; correct opposite arm and leg movement.
ROW 3: Forward RUN to RIGHT: slight forward lean, alternating powerful strides, rear leg extension and forward knee drive, briefcase stays close to body.
ROW 4: Evasive backward HOP while still facing RIGHT: crouch, push off, knees tucked, descend, two-foot landing, recover guard.
Prioritize coherent motion, correct two arms/two legs and no clipping over tiny badge text.
